units.source_text: 此外又乱七八糟地写着些愁人所想起的古歌，那笔迹非常优秀。

en.t: In addition, various old poems that come to mind for someone sunk in sorrow were written there in disorder, and the handwriting was exceedingly fine.

units.source_text: 夕雾想道：“我往常听见别人为了此种色情之事而伤心，

en.t: Yugiri thought, "Whenever I used to hear of other people grieving over this sort of love affair,

units.source_text: 觉得荒唐可笑，令人厌烦。

en.t: I found it absurd and laughable, even irritating.

units.source_text: 岂知碰到自己身上，便觉实在痛苦难堪。

en.t: But now that it has happened to me, I find it truly painful and hard to bear.
How strange; why am I so heartbroken?"

units.source_text: 他想回心转意，然而力不从心。

en.t: He tried to change his mind, but his feelings would not obey him.
